_doc: API-ALLOW-1107 (owner OD-1107-HITL, 2026-11-07): deny-by-default allowlist for outbound API calls, read by vera/api_permissions.py. Website robots.txt does not by itself settle API permission; each API is judged on its documented API authorization and source restrictions. A URL is matched to the entry with the same host and the longest path_prefix. NO MATCHING ENTRY = DENIED (code R-API-DENIED, no request sent). An entry is allowed only when its effective verdict is permitted AND its conditions validate against config/rate_limits.json (else R-API-COND, no request sent). Unreadable or invalid file = everything denied.
_owner_switch_note: owner_switch per entry: "default" (follow verdict), "permit" (owner override; requires owner_decision naming the decision ID, else denied) or "deny" (owner override). To permit Europe PMC REST after reading its terms: set entries.europepmc_rest.owner_switch to "permit", owner_decision to the decision ID (must fully match ^OD-\d{4}-[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]*$, e.g. OD-1107-HITL; the trust root is the reviewed commit of this file, because the runtime cannot read records/decisions.md and a hash pin kept in this file could be re-pinned by whoever edits the switch: the reviewer checks the ID against records/decisions.md), update evidence/read level/date, and adjust conditions if the terms state limits. No code change is needed. A permit still requires valid conditions.
_api_hosts_note: api_hosts: hosts on which EVERY path is an API call (a generic fetcher must apply this gate, not only robots/TDM). On other hosts only the entries' path prefixes are API calls; the rest is website content, gated by robots and TDM as before.
_read_level_note: read levels: 'summarizer' = WebFetch summarizing read (paraphrase level, not raw page text); 'failed' = page not readable. Evidence for the 2026-11-07 verdicts is the research read relayed in the API-ALLOW-1107 brief (summarizer level); its own findings file was not located by the implementer, so URLs marked 'carried' are from earlier project records (config/rate_limits.json sources) and need re-confirmation at review_by.
